subject: Staged close plan + MAP: security add-ons & evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Yang <claire@knot-solutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft MAP + evaluation plan for Knot Solutions

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a draft mutual action plan (Knot_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a suggested evaluation plan / timeline that aligns milestones to technical evaluation gates and procurement checkpoints. High-level proposal:

- Week 1 (POC start): access + baseline perf tests (Redwood hosted)
- Week 3: security proof-points (SOC2 evidence + audit logs sample) — OPTIONAL add-on, see pricing below
- Week 4–5: scale test on dedicated pool (if you opt for a reserved commit)
- Week 6: decision & signature (DocuSign link to follow)

Commercial signals we discussed: a 12–month committed pool triggers a 20% platform discount; earlier ramp (committed start in month 1) unlocks an additional 5% credit during first 3 months. Security add-ons (audit logs export, 12/24-month retention, premium access controls) are priced as one-time enablement + monthly fee — I put preliminary numbers in the MAP worksheet.

Please review the MAP and call out any changes to milestones or acceptance criteria. If Procurement needs a separate lane in the timeline, I can add a procurement checklist and a sample SOW/TC redline we typically use.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Knot_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46KB)
From: Claire Yang <claire@knot-solutions.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Pete Knot <pete.knot@knot-solutions.com>
Date: 2026-02-23T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation plan for Knot Solutions

Rishi —

Thanks for the draft. Overall it looks sensible. A couple of things from our side:

1) Security add-ons: we need a firm price for the audit logs export and retention tiers. We might need 24-month retention for regulatory reasons — what does that cost versus 12 months?
2) Procurement: our legal team will need to see the Data Processing Addendum and an export of the SOC2 evidence items you can provide (control descriptions + sample logs).
3) Timeline: our execs want a go/no-go decision by March 12 to align with the Q2 roadmap. Can you compress the schedule by one week if we run some parallel activities?

Also copied Pete (CTO) — he'll validate the perf targets.

Claire
Director, Platform Engineering | Knot Solutions
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Yang <claire@knot-solutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-24T08:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation plan for Knot Solutions

Claire — thanks, great questions. Quick answers and proposed adjustments:

1) Pricing (summary):
   - Audit logs export + 12mo retention: one-time enablement $6,000 + $450/mo
   - Audit logs export + 24mo retention: one-time enablement $9,500 + $750/mo
   - Premium access controls (SCIM + RBAC + session recording): one-time $8,000 + $900/mo
   - Bundle 24mo retention + premium controls: one-time $15,000 (10% bundle discount) + $1,500/mo (15% bundle discount on monthly)

   I added these line items to the MAP worksheet under the "Compliance Add-ons" tab. The enablement covers configuration, verification, and a short audit-run to validate logs are exportable in your pipeline.

2) Evidence: attached SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf with the control list and the artifacts we typically provide to customers for SOC2 review (redacted examples). We can include a live evidence session with our Security team in Week 3.

3) Timeline compression: we can parallelize the perf tests and the security evidence session — proposed revised milestones: POC start 2/27, perf and evidence run 2/27–3/06, final exec review 3/09–3/11, signature by 3/12 if all OK. This will require Procurement readiness from your side to review the SOW concurrently with the technical run.

If you confirm the compressed path I'll update the MAP and prepare a canary billing/commit schedule that ties the discount to a signed 12-month commit with a ramp schedule.

Best,
Rishi
Attachments: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (document, 98KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP + evaluation plan for Knot Solutions

Rishi / Aditya —

Couple of commercial notes for the MAP before we share the updated doc with Knot:

- Confirmed commercial levers: 12-month commit = 20% platform discount; early-ramp credit = 5% for months 1–3 when they meet the ramp thresholds in the MAP.
- We can make the compliance add-on enablement fee refundable up to 50% if they convert to Dedicated (reserved pool) within 90 days of signing — helps bridge procurement concerns about one-time costs.
- Need to confirm whether we can keep the enablement window to 10 business days; engineering ops asked for 15 business days as safe. 

I recommend we mark the MAP milestones with acceptance criteria that are unambiguous (e.g., perf: p95 < 250ms for 512 tokens; security: export delivered and validated). That will reduce rework during procurement.

Marissa
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation plan for Knot Solutions

Looping in a technical clarify: our engineering ops confirms a 12-business-day window for enablement if we do not need custom ingestors for audit logs; 18 business days if we must add a custom connector. For the compressed timeline Claire proposes, we should be explicit in the MAP about the conditional path:

- If standard export works (no connector) -> schedule enablement Week 1 of POC
- If connector needed -> schedule enablement late Week 2 and shift final validation by one week

Also, if they want 24mo retention we need to note potential storage-backend changes and the monthly fees above reflect that.

Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Yang <claire@knot-solutions.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Pete Knot <pete.knot@knot-solutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-05T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation plan for Knot Solutions

Thanks all — this is helpful. Two final items before we lock dates: 

1) Can you provide a single-row summary (SOW-friendly) of the compliance add-on options and the refundable enablement terms? We'll attach that to our procurement packet.
2) Pete flagged that the execs want the pricing scenario for a 6-month pilot with no commit vs. a 12-month commit with the discounts you mentioned. Can you add a clear, line-by-line comparison in the MAP?

If we get those by Monday (3/09) we'll aim to sign by 3/12.

Claire
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Yang <claire@knot-solutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-09T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP appendix + next steps (DocuSign & evidence session)

Claire / Pete —

Attached is a one-page appendix for Procurement that summarizes the compliance add-on options (single-row SOW format) and the refundable enablement term. I also added a two-scenario commercial table: 6-month pilot (no commit) vs 12-month commit (discount + ramp credit). Highlights:

- 6-month pilot: No platform discount, compliance add-ons billed as listed (non-refundable). Estimated first 6-month cost: $58k (platform + expected usage, ballpark).
- 12-month commit: 20% platform discount + 5% ramp credit (months 1–3). Compliance add-on enablement refundable up to 50% if converted to Dedicated within 90 days. Estimated first 12-month cost (net of discounts): $420k (annualized).

Next steps I suggest:
1) DocuSign envelope for the SOW and DPA — I'll route by EOD 3/10.
2) Evidence session with our Security team — Tue 3/10 10:00 PT (30–45m).
3) Perf validation summary and final accept criteria in the MAP to be updated by Marissa.

If those look good, I'll prepare the envelope and loop Procurement.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Knot_MAP_v2.xlsx (updated), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (attached earlier)
